correctness.rationale: For every proper nonempty S, the least cyclic boundary t gives a one-state-larger predecessor U with U b a^t=S. Induction gives the Don upper bound, and t=n-1 occurs exactly for the canonical S_k. For S_k, reverse cardinality cannot increase before n-1 inverse rotations; the first increasing inverse b-step yields S_{k+1}, forcing n letters per missing state. The embedded BFS independently checks all subsets for 2<=n<=12.
